mapper.select: SELECT /* isry.couns.dashboard.mapper.CounsDashboardMapper.selectDscsnPrfmncMainList : 상담배정 및 실적 메인 */ '월별 상담할당 수' AS SE_NAME , NVL(A.NTABRD, 0) AS NTABRD /* 게시판 할당 실적 건수 */ , NVL(A.CMNT, 0) AS CMNT /* 댓글 할당 실적 건수 */ , NVL(B.MES, 0) AS MES , NVL(B.TUBE, 0) AS TUBE FROM ( SELECT MAX(NTABRD_ASGN_NOCS) AS NTABRD /* 게시판할당건수 */ , MAX(CMNT_ASGN_NOCS) AS CMNT /* 댓글할당건수 */ FROM AYC170 WHERE RLVT_YM = #{CURR_MONTH} AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD = '324' /* 사이버상담 */ ) A , ( SELECT MAX(NTABRD_ASGN_NOCS) AS MES /* 게시판할당건수 */ , MAX(CMNT_ASGN_NOCS) AS TUBE /* 댓글할당건수 */ FROM AYC170 WHERE RLVT_YM = #{CURR_MONTH} AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD = '325' /* 사이버아웃리치 */ ) B

/* * isry.couns.dashboard.mapper.CounsDashboardMapper.selectDscsnPrfmncDetailList : 상담배정 및 실적 상세 */ WITH AAA AS ( SELECT #{CONSTT_ID} AS ID
, #{WORK_YMD} AS WORK_YMD , TO_DATE(#{WK_START_DT}, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS SYMD , TO_DATE(#{WK_END_DT}, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS EYMD
, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS WORK_YMD , TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') || '000000','YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS SYMD , TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE + 1,'YYYYMMDD') || '000000','YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS EYMD
FROM DUAL )
SELECT A.R_NUM AS R_NUM , A.SE_NAME AS SE_NAME , CASE WHEN R_NUM = 1 THEN '-' ELSE TO_CHAR(A.CHATT) END AS CHATT /* 채팅 */ , A.BBSCTT AS BBSCTT /* 비밀 */ , A.BBSSOL AS BBSSOL /* 솔로봇 */ , CASE WHEN R_NUM = 1 THEN '-' ELSE TO_CHAR(A.BBS_RPLY) END AS BBS_RPLY /* 댓글상담실 */ , A.BBSSOL_CHATT AS BBSSOL_CHATT /* 솔로봇채팅 */ , A.BBSSIM AS BBSSIM /* 웹심리 */ , A.BBSEUM AS BBSEUM /* 이음-e */ , A.BBSMOM AS BBSMOM /* 자녀맘터치법 */ , A.GRIEF AS GRIEF /* 고민해결백과 */ , CASE WHEN R_NUM = 1 THEN '-' ELSE TO_CHAR(A.BBSNAV) END AS BBSNAV /* 기타상담 */ , CASE WHEN R_NUM = 1 THEN '-' ELSE TO_CHAR(A.BBSOUT) END AS BBSOUT /* 아웃리치 */ , A.BBS_EPILOGO AS BBS_EPILOGO /* 사이버상담후기 */ , CASE WHEN R_NUM = 1 THEN '-' ELSE TO_CHAR(A.BBCRS) END AS BBCRS /* 연계상담 */ , CASE WHEN R_NUM = 1 THEN '-' ELSE TO_CHAR(A.BBSONM) END AS BBSONM /* 사례관리지원 */ FROM ( SELECT 1 AS R_NUM , '금일배정수' AS SE_NAME , 0 AS CHATT /* 채팅 */ , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '05' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS BBSCTT /* 비밀 */ , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS BBSSOL /* 솔로봇 */ , 0 AS BBSNAV /* 기타상담 */ , 0 AS BBS_RPLY /* 댓글상담실 */ , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '02' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS BBSSOL_CHATT /* 솔로봇채팅 */ , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '04' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS BBSSIM /* 웹심리 */ , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '03' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS BBSEUM /* 이음-e */ , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '15' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS BBSMOM /* 자녀맘터치법 */ , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '14' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS GRIEF /* 고민해결백과 */ , 0 AS BBSOUT /* 아웃리치 */ , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '14' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS BBS_EPILOGO /* 사이버상담후기 */ , 0 AS BBCRS /* 연계상담 */ , 0 AS BBSONM /* 연계의뢰 */ FROM AYA150 , AAA WHERE 1=1 AND TO_CHAR(REG_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') = AAA.WORK_YMD AND CONSTT_ID = AAA.ID AND DEL_YN = 'N'
UNION ALL
SELECT 2 AS R_NUM, '금일실적수' AS SE_NAME, NVL(SUM(AA.CD24), 0) AS CHATT, /* 채팅 */ NVL(SUM(CD05), 0) AS BBSCTT, /* 비밀 */ NVL(SUM(CD01), 0) AS BBSSOL, /* 솔로봇 */ NVL(SUM(CD31 + CD181 + CD182) + SUM(CD36), 0) AS BBSNAV, /* 기타상담(네이버,오픈채팅,구글) */ NVL(SUM(CD08), 0) AS BBS_RPLY, /* 댓글상담실 */ NVL(SUM(CD02), 0) AS BBSSOL_CHATT, /* 솔로봇채팅 */ NVL(SUM(CD04), 0) AS BBSSIM, /* 웹심리검사 */ NVL(SUM(CD03), 0) AS BBSEUM, /* 이음e */ NVL(SUM(CD15), 0) AS BBSMOM, /* 자녀맘터치법 */ NVL(SUM(CD14), 0) AS GRIEF, /* 고민해결백과 */ NVL(SUM(CD35), 0) AS BBSOUT, /* SNS아웃리치 */ NVL(SUM(CD12), 0) AS BBS_EPILOGO, /* 사이버상담후기 */ NVL(SUM(CD91), 0) AS BBCRS, /* 연계상담 */ NVL(SUM(CD93), 0) AS BBSONM /* 연계의뢰 */ FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) CD24 /* 채팅 */ FROM AYB200, AAA WHERE CHTT_BGNG_DT BETWEEN AAA.SYMD AND AAA.EYMD AND CNSLTNT_ID = AAA.ID AND DEL_YN = 'N' ) AA, ( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CD31, /* 네이버 */ SUM(CASE WHEN BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '18' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CD181, /* 오픈채팅 */ SUM(CASE WHEN BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '35' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CD35 /* SNS아웃리치 */ FROM AYE100, AAA WHERE FRST_REG_DT BETWEEN AAA.SYMD AND AAA.EYMD AND FRST_RGTR_ID = AAA.ID AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD IN ('31','18','35') ) BB, ( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN B.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '05' THEN CEIL(NVL(LENGTH(A.BBSCTT_CN),0)/1000) ELSE 0 END) CD05, /* 비밀 */ SUM(CASE WHEN B.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CD01, /* 솔로봇 */ SUM(CASE WHEN B.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '18' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CD182, /* 오픈채팅 */ SUM(CASE WHEN B.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '36' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CD36, /* 구글 */ SUM(CASE WHEN B.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '12' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CD12 /* 사이버상담후기 */ FROM AYE100 A, AYE120 B, AAA WHERE B.FRST_REG_DT BETWEEN AAA.SYMD AND AAA.EYMD AND A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = B.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = B.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND B.FRST_RGTR_ID = AAA.ID AND B.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD IN ('05','01','18','36','12') AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND B.DEL_YN = 'N' ) CC, ( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '08' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CD08, /* 댓글상담실 */ SUM(CASE WHEN BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '02' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CD02, /* 솔로봇채팅 */ SUM(CASE WHEN BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '03' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CD03, /* 이음e */ SUM(CASE WHEN BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '04' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CD04, /* 웹심리검사 */ SUM(CASE WHEN BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '14' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CD14, /* 고민해결백과 */ SUM(CASE WHEN BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '15' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CD15 /* 자녀맘터치법 */ FROM AYE110, AAA WHERE FRST_REG_DT BETWEEN AAA.SYMD AND AAA.EYMD AND FRST_RGTR_ID = AAA.ID AND BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD IN ('08','02','03','04','14','15') AND DEL_YN = 'N' ) DD, ( SELECT COUNT(*) CD91 /* 연계상담 */ FROM AYA120, AAA WHERE LAST_MDFCN_DT BETWEEN AAA.SYMD AND AAA.EYMD AND LAST_MDFR_ID = AAA.ID AND DEL_YN = 'N' ) EE, ( SELECT COUNT(*) CD92 /* 사후관리 */ FROM AYA190, AAA WHERE LAST_MDFCN_DT BETWEEN AAA.SYMD AND AAA.EYMD AND LAST_MDFR_ID = AAA.ID AND DEL_YN = 'N' ) FF, ( SELECT COUNT(*) CD93 --연계의뢰 FROM SEB400 A, SCA100 B, SAA200 C, AAA WHERE A.RQST_YMD BETWEEN AAA.SYMD AND AAA.EYMD AND A.CLINT_NO = B.ENFSN_NO AND B.ENFSN_NO = C.ENFSN_NO AND C.USER_ID = AAA.ID AND A.RQST_UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = 'U11' ) GG ) A

SELECT /* isry.couns.dashboard.mapper.CounsDashboardMapper.selectMnthngSchdlcyberDscsnList : 오늘의일정 사이버상담 */ B.USER_ID AS CNSLTNT_ID /* 상담원아이디 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(D.FLNM_ENCPT) AS CNSLTNT_NM /* 상담원명 */ , A.BGNG_HR AS BGNG_HR /* 시작시간 */ , B.WORK_YMD AS WORK_YMD /* 근무일자 */ , CASE WHEN A.BGNG_HR = '00:00' THEN '1' WHEN A.BGNG_HR = '03:30' THEN '2' WHEN A.BGNG_HR = '07:00' THEN '3' WHEN A.BGNG_HR = '10:30' THEN '4' WHEN A.BGNG_HR = '14:00' THEN '5' WHEN A.BGNG_HR = '17:30' THEN '6' WHEN A.BGNG_HR = '20:30' THEN '7' ELSE '' END AS TIME_SE_NUM /* 기간구분번호 */ , CASE WHEN E.USER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS VCATN_YN /* 휴가여부 */ FROM AYC110 A /* 근무배정표_월별 */ , AYC100 B /* 근무배정표_일별 */ , SAA200 C /* 사용자 */ , SCA100 D /* 종사자 */ , ( SELECT MAX(USER_ID) AS USER_ID FROM AYC130 /* 사이버1388휴가 */ WHERE 1=1 AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND APLY_SE_CD = '01' AND APRV_STTS_SE_CD = '2' AND #{P_TODAY} BETWEEN VCATN_BGNG_YMD AND VCATN_END_YMD GROUP BY USER_ID ) E WHERE B.WORK_YMD = #{P_TODAY} /* '20230615' , P_TODAY */ AND A.TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD = '324' AND A.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO = B.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO AND B.USER_ID = C.USER_ID AND C.ENFSN_NO = D.ENFSN_NO AND B.USER_ID = E.USER_ID(+) ORDER BY A.BGNG_HR

SELECT /* isry.couns.dashboard.mapper.CounsDashboardMapper.selectMnthngSchdlcyberOutList : 오늘의일정 사이버아웃리치 */ B.USER_ID AS CNSLTNT_ID /* 상담원아이디 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(D.FLNM_ENCPT) AS CNSLTNT_NM /* 상담원명 */ , A.BGNG_HR AS BGNG_HR /* 시작시간 */ , B.WORK_YMD AS WORK_YMD /* 근무일자 */ , CASE WHEN A.BGNG_HR = '00:00' THEN '1' WHEN A.BGNG_HR = '17:30' THEN '2' WHEN A.BGNG_HR = '20:30' THEN '3' ELSE '' END AS TIME_SE_NUM /* 기간구분번호 */ , CASE WHEN E.USER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS VCATN_YN /* 휴가여부 */ FROM AYC110 A , AYC100 B , SAA200 C , SCA100 D , ( SELECT MAX(USER_ID) AS USER_ID FROM AYC130 WHERE 1=1 AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND APLY_SE_CD = '01' AND APRV_STTS_SE_CD = '2' AND #{P_TODAY} BETWEEN VCATN_BGNG_YMD AND VCATN_END_YMD GROUP BY USER_ID ) E WHERE B.WORK_YMD = #{P_TODAY} AND A.TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD = '325' AND A.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO = B.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO AND B.USER_ID = C.USER_ID AND C.ENFSN_NO = D.ENFSN_NO AND B.USER_ID = E.USER_ID(+) ORDER BY A.BGNG_HR

SELECT /* isry.couns.dashboard.mapper.CounsDashboardMapper.selectMngrMntrgSchdlList : 오늘의일정 모니터링 담당자 조회 */ A.CNSLTNT_ID AS CNSLTNT_ID /* 상담사아이디 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(A.CNSLTNT_NM_ENCPT) AS CNSLTNT_NM /* 상담사명 */ , A.MNGR_INPT_YMD AS MNGR_INPT_YMD /* 관리자입력일자 */ , A.INDEX_SN AS INDEX_SN /* 색인일련번호 */ , C.WRD_TELNO AS WRD_TELNO /* 유선전화번호 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(C.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT) AS MBL_TELNO_ENCPT /* 휴대전화번호암호화 */ FROM AYC160 A , SAA200 B , SCA100 C WHERE A.CNSLTNT_ID = B.USER_ID AND B.ENFSN_NO = C.ENFSN_NO AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND C.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.MNGR_INPT_YMD = #{P_TODAY}

SELECT /* isry.couns.dashboard.mapper.CounsDashboardMapper.selectBbsonmList : 실시간게시판 게시글목록 */ BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AS BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO , WRTR_NM_ENCPT AS WRTR_NM_ENCPT , WRTR_ID AS WRTR_ID , CRT_DT AS CRT_DT , BBSCTT_CN AS BBSCTT_CN FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER( ORDER BY FRST_REG_DT DESC ) AS R_NUM , BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AS BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /* 게시글고유번호 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(WRTR_NM_ENCPT) AS WRTR_NM_ENCPT /* 성함 */ , FRST_RGTR_ID AS WRTR_ID /* 아이디 */ , TO_CHAR(FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS CRT_DT /* 등록일자 */ , BBSCTT_CN AS BBSCTT_CN /* 게시글내용 */ FROM AYE100 WHERE BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '28' /* 게시글유형구분코드 */ AND (DEL_YN != 'Y' OR DEL_YN IS NULL) )
WHERE R_NUM < 7
ORDER BY BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO DESC

SELECT /* isry.couns.dashboard.mapper.CounsDashboardMapper.selectSpclaList : 특별관리대상자 게시글목록*/ A.DSCSN_DTL_CN AS DSCSN_DTL_CN , A.REG_DT AS REG_DT FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER( ORDER BY A.FRST_REG_DT DESC ) AS R_NUM , A.DSCSN_DTL_CN AS DSCSN_DTL_CN /* 상담상세내용 */ , TO_CHAR(A.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS REG_DT /* 등록날짜 */ FROM AYB110 A , SAA200 B , SCA100 C WHERE (A.DEL_YN != 'Y' OR A.DEL_YN IS NULL) AND A.CNSLTNT_ID = B.USER_ID AND B.ENFSN_NO = C.ENFSN_NO AND A.CLIENA_ID IS NOT NULL ) A
WHERE R_NUM < 7

SELECT /* isry.couns.dashboard.mapper.CounsDashboardMapper.selectLvffcPrcsBassInfo - 상담원 퇴근시간 조회 */ INDEX_SN AS INDEX_SN /* 색인일련번호 */ , CONSTT_ID AS CONSTT_ID /* 상담자아이디 */ , TO_CHAR(ATENDB_DT , 'MM/DD HH24:MI') AS ATENDB_DT /* 출근일시 */ , TO_CHAR(LVFFC_DT , 'MM/DD HH24:MI') AS LVFFC_DT /* 퇴근일시 */ FROM AYC495 WHERE CONSTT_ID = #{CONSTT_ID} /* 상담원아이디 */
AND WORK_YMD = #{WORK_YMD} /* 퇴근일자 */
AND WORK_YMD = #{P_TODAY} /* 퇴근일자 */

/* * isry.couns.dashboard.mapper.CounsDashboardMapper.selectNextAtndb - 금일근무현황_다음출근 * 2023.06.15 New Query - Jeong.Won.Je */
WITH WORK_SET AS ( SELECT MIN(WORK_YMD) AS WORK_YMD , MIN(USER_ID) AS CONSTT_ID FROM AYC100 A WHERE 1=1 AND A.USER_ID = #{CONSTT_ID} AND A.WORK_YMD > #{P_TODAY} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM AYC130 WHERE 1=1 AND USER_ID = A.USER_ID AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND APLY_SE_CD = '01' AND APRV_STTS_SE_CD = '2' AND VCATN_BGNG_YMD <= A.WORK_YMD AND VCATN_END_YMD >= A.WORK_YMD ) ) SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.WORK_YMD), 'MM/DD') || ' ' || B.BGNG_HR AS WORK_YMD FROM AYC100 A , AYC110 B , WORK_SET WHERE B.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO = A.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO AND A.USER_ID = WORK_SET.CONSTT_ID AND A.WORK_YMD = WORK_SET.WORK_YMD

/* * isry.couns.dashboard.mapper.CounsDashboardMapper.selectTodayWorkYmd : 상담원 오늘 근무일자 조회 */ SELECT MAX(T1.WORK_YMD) AS WORK_YMD FROM ( SELECT TO_DATE(A.WORK_YMD || REPLACE(B.BGNG_HR, ':', '') || '00', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') - 1/12 AS WORK_DT , WORK_YMD AS WORK_YMD FROM AYC100 A , AYC110 B WHERE 1=1 AND B.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO = A.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO AND A.USER_ID = #{CONSTT_ID} ) T1
WHERE T1.WORK_DT < SYSDATE
